title: Wiemer (v2)
description: Gallery-quiet off-white and flat grey bands, near-black ink, one loud orange for tags and a full spec band, and a utility blue for form buttons. Instrument Sans set large and viewport-fluid, DM Mono for tiny uppercase tags, flat 14px cards.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is an ink-black sibling with the same orange and blue
Instrument Sans stands in for Neue Montreal and DM Mono for Supply Mono (both closed)
gutter and section padding grow at lg (24 → 40 px, 3 → 7 rem)
name: wiemer-v2-theme
